query:
UPDATE documents
               SET title = CASE
                       WHEN $3::text IS NOT NULL
                            AND (btrim(title) = '' OR title = canonical_url OR title = original_url)
                           THEN $3
                       ELSE title
                   END,
                   author = COALESCE(NULLIF(author, ''), $4),
                   excerpt = COALESCE(NULLIF(excerpt, ''), $5),
                   updated_at = now()
               WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2
